Chapitre I : Du contrôle

articles.heading: Igisobanuro cy’umutungo ndangamuco Muri aya Masezerano, ibintu bikurikira, hatitawe ku nkomoko yabyo cyangwa k’ ubifite,
articles.text:
bifatwa nk’umutungo ndangamuco:
a) imitungo yimukanwa cyangwa itimukanwa
ifite agaciro gakomeye mu murage ndangamuco
w’abantu b’aha n’aha, harimo nk’inzibutso
zihatse ubuhanga mu byo guhanga inyubako,
iz’ubugeni cyangwa iz’amateka, zaba
iz’amadini cyangwa atari izayo, ahantu
hataburuwe ibisigaratongo, inyubako ziri
ahantu hamwe, bitewe n’uko zimeze, zifite
agaciro mu rwego rw’amateka cyangwa
rw’ubugeni, ibihangano by’ubugeni, inyandiko
za kera zandikishijwe intoki, ibitabo n’ibindi
bintu bifite agaciro mu rwego rw’ubugeni,
urw’amateka cyangwa urw’ubushakashatsi ku
bisigaratongo, kimwe n’ububiko bw’ibintu byo
mu rwego rwa siyansi n’ububiko bw’ibitabo
bw’ingenzi cyangwa ishyinguranyandiko
cyangwa ibituburano by’ibintu byavuzwe
haruguru;
b) inyubako zubakiwe cyangwa zikoreshwa mu
kubika cyangwa kumurika ibintu ndangamuco
byimukanwa byasobanuwe mu gace ka (a)
zirimo ingoro ndangamurage, inzu z’ibitabo
zikomeye, inzu zishyingurwamo inyandiko,
kimwe n’ubwihisho bugenewe guhishwamo,
mu gihe cy’intambara, imitungo ndangamuco
yimukanwa isobanurwa mu gace ka (a) ;
c) ahantu hari umubare munini w’imitungo
ndangamuco isobanurwa mu duce (a) na (b),
hitwa «ahantu hari ibintu ndangamateka».

articles.heading: Imitunganyirize y’ubugenzuzi Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyikimara kwinjira mu ntambara irebwa n’ibiteganywa mu
articles.text:
ngingo ya 18 y’Amasezerano:
a) kigomba gushyiraho ugihagarariye ku
bijyanye n’imitungo ndangamuco iri ku butaka
bwacyo; niba kandi hari intara y’ikindi gihugu
gifashe, kigomba gushyiraho ugihagarariye
udasanzwe ushinzwe imitungo ndangamuco iri
muri iyo ntara;
b) Igihugu kirengezi gihagarariye inyungu za
buri gihugu gihanganye n’icyo gihugu kiri muri
aya Masezerano, gishyiraho intumwa zacyo
zikoherezwa muri icyo kivuzwe nyuma,
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 3 ikurikira;
c) Hashyirwaho Komiseri Mukuru ushinzwe
imitungo ndangamuco muri icyo gihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano, hakurikijwe ingingo ya 4
ikurikira.

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho ry’intumwa z’ibihugu birengezi Igihugu kirengezi gishyiraho intumwa zacyo gitoranyije mu bagize abakozi bacyo
articles.text:
b’abadipolomate cyangwa bo mu rwego
rw’itsinda ry’abantu bahagarariye inyungu
z’igihugu mu kindi, cyangwa, byemewe
n’igihugu aho akazi kazakorerwa, batoranyijwe
mu bandi bantu.

articles.heading: Kubaha imitungo ndangamuco 1.Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byiyemeje kubaha imitungo ndangamuco iri ku
articles.text:
butaka bwabyo bwite ndetse n’iri ku butaka
bw’ibindi bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano,
byirinda gukoresha uwo mutungo n’ibiwukikije
bya hafi cyangwa ibikoresho byifashishwa mu
kuwurinda mu bintu ibyo ari byo byose
byawukururira gusenywa cyangwa kwangizwa
mu gihe cy’intambara, kandi bikirinda gukora
igikorwa cy’intambara cyose cyakwibasira bene
uwo mutungo.
2. Inshingano zivugwa mu gika cya mbere
cy’iyi ngingo zishobora gukurwaho gusa iyo
hari impamvu zikomeye za gisirikare zisaba ko
byanze bikunze izo nshingano zirengagizwa.
3. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
byiyemeza kandi kubuza, gukumira no
guhagarika mu gihe bibaye ngombwa ubujura
ubwo ari bwo bwose, ubusahuzi cyangwa
irigiswa ry’umutungo ndangamuco ndetse
n’ibindi bikorwa byose byo kwangiza byibasira
umutungo ndangamuco. Byiyemeza kutigera
byitiza umutungo ndangamuco wimukanwa uri
ku butaka bw’ikindi gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano.
4. Byiyemeza kutazakora igikorwa cyose cyo
kwihimura cyibasira umutungo ndangamuco.
5. Nta gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishobora kwihunza inshingano gihabwa n’iyi
ngingo ku bijyanye n’uko kigomba kwitwara ku
kindi gihugu na cyo kiyarimo, cyitwaje ko icyo
gihugu kindi kitashyize mu bikorwa ingamba zo
kurinda umutungo ndangamuco zivugwa mu
ngingo ya 3.

articles.heading: Ifatwa 1. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyose gifashe ubutaka bw’ikindi gihugu na cyo kiri
articles.text:
muri aya Masezerano, bwaba bwose cyangwa
igice cyabwo, kigomba gufasha mu buryo
bushoboka bwose inzego z’ubuyobozi zibifitiye
ububasha zo mu gihugu cyafashwe kurinda no
kubungabunga imitungo ndangamuco yacyo.
2. Nibigaragara ko ari ngombwa gufata ingamba
zihutirwa zo kubungabunga imitungo
ndangamuco iri mu karere kafashwe yangijwe
n’ibikorwa bya gisirikare, bikagaragara kandi
ko abayobozi babifitiye ububasha bo mu gihugu
cyafashwe batabishobora, igihugu cyafashe ako
karere kigomba gukora uko gishoboye kose
kigafata ingamba z’agateganyo za ngombwa
cyane, mu bufatanye bwa hafi n’abo bayobozi.
3. Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kiri muri aya
Masezerano gifite guverinoma ifatwa n’abagize
umutwe wigometse ku butegetsi nka
guverinoma yemewe n’amategeko, gikangurira
mu gihe bishoboka, abagize uwo mutwe kwita
ku nshingano zo kubahiriza ingingo zo mu
Masezerano zerekeye kubaha imitungo
ndangamuco.

articles.heading: Inshingano za Komiseri Mukuru 1. Komiseri Mukuru ku mitungo ndangamuco ashinzwe gusuzuma, hamwe n’uhagarariye
articles.text:
igihugu akoreramo imirimo ye n’intumwa
bireba, ibibazo byose yamenyeshejwe ku
bijyanye n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’Amasezerano.
2. Afite ububasha ku gufata ibyemezo n’ubwo
gushyiraho abantu mu bihe biteganywa muri
aya Mabwiriza.
3. Abyumvikanyeho n’igihugu akoreramo, afite
uburenganzira bwo gutegeka ko hakorwa
iperereza cyangwa kuriyobora we ubwe.
4. Akora, ku bihugu biri mu ntambara cyangwa
ku bihugu birengezi byabyo, ubuvugizi bwose
abona ko bwafasha mu iyubahirizwa
ry’Amasezerano.
5. Ategura raporo za ngombwa ku ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ry’Amasezerano kandi akazigeza ku
bihugu zireba no ku bihugu birengezi byabyo.
Agenera inyandukuro Umuyobozi Mukuru
w’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku
Burezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco, ushobora
gukoresha gusa amakuru azirimo yo ku rwego
rwa tekinike.
6. Iyo nta gihugu kirengezi cyashyizweho,
Komiseri Mukuru ni we ukora imirimo igihugu
kirengezi gishinzwe ivugwa mu ngingo ya 21
n’iya 22 z’Amasezerano.

articles.heading: Ingamba za gisirikare 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byiyemeza, uhereye mu gihe cy’amahoro,
articles.text:
kwinjiza ingingo zatuma aya Masezerano
yubahirizwa mu mategeko rusange
n’amabwiriza akurikizwa mu ngabo zabyo, no
gucengeza mu ngabo zabyo imyumvire yo
kubaha imico n’imitungo ndangamuco
by’abantu bose.
2. Ibihugu bihuriye muri aya Masezerano
byiyemeza ko uhereye mu gihe bifite amahoro
bitegura cyangwa bigashyira mu ngabo zabyo
inzego cyangwa abakozi bihariye bashinzwe
kwita ku iyubahirizwa ry’imitungo ndangamuco
no gufatanya n’abayobozi bo mu nzego za
gisivili bashinzwe kurinda uwo mutungo
ndangamuco.
Chapitre. II : Ukurengerwa kwihariye

articles.heading: Itangwa ry’uburengezi bwihariye 1. Kurengerwa mu buryo bwihariye bishobora kwemerwa ku mubare runaka w’ubwihisho
articles.text:
bwagenewe kubikwamo imitungo ndangamuco
yimukanwa mu gihe cy’intambara, uw’ahantu
hari ibimenyetso ndangamateka, n’uw’indi
mitungo ndangamuco itimukanwa ifite agaciro
gakomeye, bipfa gusa kuba:
a) biri ahantu hari intera ihagije hagati yabyo
n’ahari inganda zikomeye cyangwa ahantu
hafatwa nk’intego ya gisirikare, urugero
nk’ikibuga cy’indege, ikigo cya radiyo, ikigo
gikora ibijyanye no gucunga umutekano
w’igihugu, icyambu cyangwa ahategerwa
gariyamoshi bikomeye mu rugero runaka
cyangwa ibikorwa remezo by’itumanaho;
b) bidakoreshwa ku mpamvu za gisirikare
2 Ubwihisho bw’imitungo ndangmuco
yimukanwa bushobora kandi na none guhabwa
uburinzi bwihariye hatitawe ku hantu
buherereye, mu gihe bigaragara ko uko
bwubatse budashobora kwangizwa n’ ibisasu
uko byagenda kose
3. Ahantu hari ibimenyetso ndangamateka
hafatwa nk’ahakoreshwa mu bikorwa bya
gisirikare igihe cyose hakoreshwa mu gutwara
abasirikare cyangwa ibikoresho bya gisirikare,
n’iyo byaba bikiri mu nzira bitaragera iyo bijya.
Ni na ko hafatwa mu gihe cyose hakorerwa
imirimo ifitanye isano n’ibikorwa bya
gisirikare, hakambitse abasirikare cyangwa
hakorerwa ibikoresho by’intambara.
4. Kuba imitungo ndangamuco ivugwa mu gika
cya mbere cyavuzwe haruguru irinzwe
n’abarinzi bafite intwaro bashinzwe uwo
murimo ku buryo bwihariye cyangwa hafi y’iyo
mitungo ndangamuco hari abapolisi bashinzwe
kubungabunga umutekano rusange nk’uko
bisanzwe, ntibifatwa nko gukoresha iyo
mitungo mu mirimo ya gisirikare.
5. Iyo hari imitungo ndangamuco iyo ari yo yose
mu ivugwa mu gika cya mbere cy’iyi ngingo iri
hafi y’ahantu hafatwa nk’intego ya gisirikare
nk’uko isobanurwa muri icyo gika, iyo mitungo
na yo ishobora kurengerwa mu buryo bwihariye
niba igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gisaba
ko irengerwa cyiyemeza ko mu gihe
cy’intambara kitazakoresha aho hantu, kandi
by’umwihariko aho hantu haba ari icyambu, aho
bategera gariyamoshi cyangwa ikibuga
cy’indege cya gisirikare, icyo gihugu
kikiyemeza guhagarika abahanyuraga bose
bagakoresha izindi nzira. Muri icyo gihe, izo
nzira zindi zakoreshwa zigomba gutegurwa mu
gihe cy’amahoro.
6.Ukurengerwa kwihariye guhabwa imitungo
ndangamuco binyuze mu kuyandika “mu
Gitabo mpuzamahanga cy’imitungo
ndangamuco kiri mu burinzi budasanzwe”. Iri
yandikwa rikorwa gusa hakurikijwe
ibitegenyijwe muri aya Masezerano n’ibisabwa
n’amabwiriza ashyira mu bikorwa aya
Masezerano.

articles.heading: Abasimbura b’ibihugu birengezi Iyo igihugu kiri mu ntambara kidakorerwa cyangwa kitagikorerwa ibyo kigombwa
articles.text:
n’igihugu kirengezi, igihugu kidafite aho
kibogamiye gishobora gusabwa gukora imirimo
y’igihugu kirengezi mu rwego rwo gushyiraho
Komiseri Mukuru ushinzwe imitungo
ndangamuco hakurikijwe uburyo buteganywa
mu ngingo ya 4 haruguru. Komiseri Mukuru
ushyizweho, iyo bibaye ngombwa ashinga
abagenzuzi gukora imirimo yagombaga
gukorwa n’intumwa z’ibihugu birengezi nk’uko
igaragazwa muri aya Mabwiriza.

articles.heading: Amafaranga akoreshwa Imishahara n’amafaranga akoreshwa na Komiseri Mukuru ushinzwe imitungo
articles.text:
ndangamuco, abagenzuzi n’impuguke,
byishingirwa n’igihugu bakoreramo ubutumwa
bwabo. Imishahara n’amafaranga akoreshwa
n’intumwa z’ibihugu birengezi
byumvikanwaho hagati y’ibyo bihugu birengezi
n’ibihugu ibyo bihugu birengezi bireberera
inyungu zabyo.
Umutwe wa II : Kurengerwa ku buryo
bwihariye

articles.heading: Ivanwaho ry’ubudahangarwa 1. Iyo kimwe mu bihugu biri muri aya Masezerano kirenze ku nshingano zacyo
articles.text:
ziteganywa mu ngingo ya 9 ku bijyanye
n’umutungo ndangamuco uwo ari wo wose
urengerwa ku buryo bwihariye, Igihugu
gihanganye na cyo kiba kibohowe ku nshingano
yacyo yo kwishingira ubudahangarwa bw’uwo
mutungo mu gihe cyose uko kurenga ku
nshingano kugikomeje. Ariko kandi, igihe
cyose bishoboka, icyo Gihugu mukeba kibanza
gusaba ko kurenga ku nshingano biba
byahagaritswe mu gihe ntarengwa cyumvikana.
2. Uretse mu gihe giteganywa mu gika cya
mbere cy’iyi ngingo, mu bindi bihe
ubudahangarwa bw’imitungo ndangamuco
irengerwa ku buryo bwihariye bukurwaho gusa
mu bihe bidasanzwe bitewe n’impamvu
zikomeye za gisirikare kandi ntakumirwa, kandi
uko gukurwaho kukagumaho gusa mu gihe
cyose izo mpamvu zigikomeje. Izo mpamvu
zikomeye za gisirikare zemezwa n’umusirikare
mukuru uyoboye umutwe w’ingabo ungana na
diviziyo cyangwa uyirenze. Mu gihe cyose
imimerere ibyemera, icyemezo cyo kuvanaho
ubudahangarwa kimenyeshwa igihugu
bihanganye hasigaye igihe gihagije ngo
gitangire kubahirizwa.
3. Igihugu kivanyeho ubudahangarwa kigomba
kubimenyesha, mu nyandiko, Komiseri Mukuru
ushinzwe imitungo ndangamuco uteganywa mu
Mabwiriza y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’aya
Masezerano mpuzamahanga, kikagaragaza
n’impamvu kibuvanyeho.
Igice cya III : Ubwikorezi bw’imitungo
ndangamuco

articles.heading: Igitabo mpuzamahanga cy’imitungo ndangamuco irengerwa ku buryo bwihariye 1. Hashyizweho “Igitabo mpuzamahanga
articles.text:
cy’imitungo ndangamuco irengerwa ku buryo
bwihariye”.
2. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami
ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Burezi,
Ubumenyi n’Umuco ashinzwe kubika icyo
gitabo. Ashyikiriza inyandukuro zacyo
Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye n’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano.
3. Igitabo kigabanyijemo ibice, buri gice kikaba
gihuye n’izina ry’igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano. Buri gice kigabanyijemo ibika
bitatu bifite imitwe ikurikira : Ubwihisho,
Ahantu hari ibimenyetso ndangamateka, Indi
mitungo ndangamuco itimukanwa. Umuyobozi
Mukuru agena ibisobanuro birambuye
bishyirwa muri buri gice.
Ingingingo ya 13: Gusaba iyandikwa
1. Igihugu cyose kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishobora gusaba Umuyobozi Mukuru
w’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku
Burezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco, kwandika mu
gitabo ubwihisho, ahantu hari ibimenyetso
ndangamateka cyangwa indi mitungo
ndangamuco itimukanwa, biri ku butaka
bwacyo. Muri iryo saba, igihugu kigomba
gutangamo ibisobanuro biranga aho uwo
mutungo uherereye, kandi kikemeza ko wujuje
ibisabwa biteganywa mu ngingo ya 8
y’Amasezerano.
2. Mu gihe cy’ifatwa, igihugu cyafashe gifite
ububasha bwo gusaba iyandikwa.
3. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami
ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye rishinzwe
Uburezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco yohereza
bidatinze inyandukuro y’ubusabe
bw’iyandikwa kuri buri gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano.

articles.heading: Ubwikorezi mu bihe byihutirwa 1. Niba kimwe mu bihugu biri muri aya Masezerano kibona ko imitungo ndangamuco
articles.text:
imwe n’imwe ikeneye kwimurwa ku mpamvu
z’umutekano wayo kandi ko byihutirwa ku
buryo gukurikiza uburyo buteganywa mu
ngingo ya 12 bitashoboka, cyane cyane nko mu
ntangiriro y’intambara, ubwikorezi bwabyo
bushobora gushyirwaho ikirango cyihariye
gisobanurwa mu ngingo ya 16, bipfa gusa kuba
isabwa ry’ubudahangarwa rivugwa mu ngingo
ya 12 ritarakorwa cyangwa ryaranzwe. Igihe
cyose bishoboka, igihugu bihanganye
kimenyeshwa iby’iryo yimurwa. Icyakora
ubwikorezi bw’imitungo ndangamuco
bwerekeza ku butaka bw’ikindi gihugu
ntibushobora na rimwe gushyirwaho ikirango
cyihariye, keretse bubaye bwarahawe
ubudahangarwa ku buryo bweruye.
2. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bigomba gufata uko bishoboka kose ingamba za
ngombwa ku buryo ubwikorezi buvugwa mu
gika cya mbere cy’iyi ngingo buriho ikirango
cyihariye butibasirwa n’ibikorwa by’intambara.

articles.heading: Itambamira 1. Buri gihugu mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano gishobora gutambamira iyandikwa
articles.text:
ry’umutungo ndangamuco kikabimenyekanisha
binyuze mu ibaruwa yandikirwa Umuyobozi
Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye ryita ku Burezi, Ubumenyi
n’Umuco. Iyo baruwa igomba kuba
yamugezeho mu gihe cy’amezi ane kuva ku
itariki yohererejeho inyandukuro y’ubusabe
bw’iyandikwa.
2. Iryo tambamira rigomba kugaragaza
impamvu rishingiyeho, impamvu zikaba zaba
gusa ari ukuba :
a) umutungo utari ndangamuco;
b) ibisabwa mu ngingo ya 8 y’Amasezerano
butuzuye.
3. Umuyobozi Mukuru yohereza bidatinze
inyandukuro y’ibaruwa y’itambamira ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano. Iyo ari
ngombwa, asaba inama Komite Mpuzamahanga
ishinzwe Inzibutso, ahantu ndangabugeni na
ndangamateka n’ahataburuwe ibisigaratongo,
ndetse akaba yasaba inama ikindi kigo cyose
kibishoboye cyangwa undi muyobozi wese
ubifshoboye.
4. Umuyobozi Mukuru, cyangwa igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano cyasabye iyandikwa
ry’umutungo ndangamuco mu Gitabo,
bashobora gukora ubuvugizi bwose babona ko
ari ngombwa ku gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano cyaritambamiye, hagamijwe ko
cyakwisubiraho kikavanaho iryo tambamira.
5. Iyo igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
cyasabye mu gihe cy’amahoro iyandikwa
ry’umutungo ndangamuco mu Gitabo, cyinjiye
mu ntambara mbere y’uko iryo yandikwa
rikorwa, umutungo ndangamuco bireba uhita
wandikwa mu Gitabo by’agateganyo
n’Umuyobozi Mukuru, mu gihe hagitegerejwe
ko itambamira ryazakorwa cyangwa iryaba
ryaramaze gukorwa ryemezwa, cyangwa ko
igihugu cyarikoze kisubiraho cyangwa se ko
riteshwa agaciro.
6. Iyo amezi atandatu ashize, uhereye ku itariki
Umuyobozi Mukuru yakiriyeho ibaruwa
y’itambamira, uwo Muyobozi Mukuru
atarabona ubutumwa bw’igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano cyakoze iryo tambamira bwemeza
ko cyisubiyeho, igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano cyasabye iyandikwa ry’umutungo
ndangamuco mu Gitabo gishobora kwitabaza
ubukemurampaka hakurikijwe uburyo
buteganywa mu gika gikurikira
7. Isaba ry’ubukemurampaka rigomba gukorwa
mu gihe kitarenze umwaka umwe ukurikira
itariki Umuyobozi Mukuru yakiriyeho ibaruwa
y’itambamira. Buri gihugu mu bifitanye
ukutumvikana gishyiraho umukemurampaka.
Iyo isaba ry’iyandikwa ry’umutungo
ndangamuco ryatambamiwe n’ibihugu bihuriye
muri aya Masezerano birenze kimwe, ibyo
bihugu byakoze itambamira bishyiraho
umukemurampaka umwe byumvikanyeho.
Abo bakemurampaka babiri bihitiramo
umuyobozi w’abakemurampaka ku rutonde
mpuzamahanga ruteganywa mu ngingo ya
mbere y’aya Mabwiriza. Iyo abo
bakemurampaka bananiwe kwemeranya ku wo
bahitamo basaba Perezida w’Urukiko
Mpuzamahanga gushyiraho umuyobozi
w’abakemurampaka, ushobora kudatoranywa
byanze bikunze ku rutonde mpuzamahanga.
Urwo rukiko nkemurampaka rwishyiriraho
uburyo bugomba gukurikizwa mu isuzuma
ry’ikibazo. Ibyemezo byarwo ntibijuririrwa.
8. Buri gihugu mu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
gishobora gutangaza, igihe cyose havutse
impaka gifitemo uruhare, ko kitifuza gukoresha
ubukemurampaka buteganywa mu gika
kibanza. Muri icyo gihe, Umuyobozi Mukuru
ashyikiriza itambamira ry’ubusabe
bw’iyandikishwa ibihugu biri muri aya
Masezerano. Iryo tambamira riba ndakuka iyo
ryemejwe n’ubwiganze bwa bibiri bya gatatu
(2/3) by’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
byatoye. Itora rikorwa binyuze mu kohereza
ubutumwa, keretse Umuyobozi Mukuru
w’Ishami ryita ku Burezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco,
abonye ko ari ngombwa gutumiza inama
ashingiye ku bubasha ahabwa n’ingingo ya 27
y’Amasezerano. Mu gihe Umuyobozi Mukuru
afashe icyemezo cyo gukoresha itora
hakoreshejwe amabaruwa, asaba ibihugu biri
muri aya Masezerano kumugezaho amajwi
yabyo mu mabaruwa afunze neza mu gihe
cy’amezi atandatu uhereye ku munsi
byabisabiweho.

articles.heading: Iyandikwa 1. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Burezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco yandikisha mu gitabo,
articles.text:
hakurikijwe nomero z’uko ikurikirana,
umutungo ndangamuco wose wasabiwe
iyandikwa, iyo nta gihugu cyabitambamiye mu
gihe giteganywa mu gika cya mbere cy’ingingo
ya 14.
2. Iyo itambamira ryakozwe, kandi
bitabangamiye ibiteganywa mu gika cya 5
cy’ingingo ya 14, Umuyobozi Mukuru yandika
umutungo ndangamuco mu Gitabo ari uko gusa
igihugu cyakoze itambamira cyisubiyeho
cyangwa iryo tambamira rikaba ritaremejwe ku
buryo ndakuka hakurikijwe uburyo buvugwa
mu gika cya 7 cy’ingingo ya 14 cyangwa
ubuvugwa mu gika cya 8 cy’iyo ngingo.
3. Mu bibazo byose birebwa n’igika cya 3
cy’ingingo ya 11, Umuyobozi Mukuru yandika
umutungo ndangamuco mu Gitabo iyo
abisabwe na Komiseri Mukuru ushinzwe
imitungo ndangamuco.
4. Umuyobozi Mukuru yoherereza bidatinze
Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye inyandukuro ihuje
n’umwimerere y’ibyanditswe mu Gitabo,
akanayoherereza ibindi bihugu byose bivugwa
mu ngingo ya 30 n’iya 32 z’Amasezerano iyo
abisabwe n’igihugu cyasabye iryo yandikwa.
Iyandikwa ritangira kugira agaciro hashize
iminsi mirongo itatu iryo yohereza rikozwe.

articles.heading: Isibwa 1. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Burezi, Ubumenyi, n’Umuco ategeka ko umutungo
articles.text:
ndangamuco wanditswe mu Gitabo usibwa:
a) iyo bisabwe n’igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano uwo mutungo ndangamuco
ubereye ku butaka;
b) iyo Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyari
cyarasabye iyandikwa ryawo cyivanye mu
Masezerano kandi uko kwivana mu Masezerano
kukaba kwaratangiye gukurikizwa;
c) mu gihe cyihariye giteganywa mu gika cya 5
cy’ingingo ya 14, iyo itambamira ryemejwe
bidasubirwaho hakurikijwe uburyo buvugwa
mu gika cya 7 cy’ingingo ya 14 cyangwa
ubuteganywa mu gika cya 8 cy’iyo ngingo.
2. Umuyobozi Mukuru yoherereza bidatinze
Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye n’ibihugu byose byahawe
inyandukuro y’iyandikwa ry’uwo mutungo mu
Gitabo, inyandukuro ihuje n’umwimerere
y’isibwa ryawo mu Gitabo. Isibwa ritangira
kugira agaciro hashize iminsi mirongo itatu iryo
yohereza rikozwe.
Igice cya III: Ubwikorezi bw’imitungo
ndangamuco

articles.heading: Ikoreshwa ry’ikirango 1. Ikirango cyisubiyemo inshuro eshatu gishobora gukoreshwa gusa mu kuranga
articles.text:
a) imitungo ndangamuco itimukanwa irengerwa
mu buryo bwihariye;
(b) ubwikorezi bw’imitungo ndangamuco mu
buryo buteganyijwe mu ngingo ya 12 n’iya 13;
c) ubwihisho buhutiyeho, mu buryo buteganywa
mu Mabwiriza y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’Amasezerano.
2. Ikirango cyihariye gishobora gukoreshwa
cyonyine gusa mu kuranga:
a) imitungo ndangamuco itarengerwa ku buryo
bwihariye;
b) abantu bashinzwe imirimo y’ubugenzuzi
hakurikijwe Amabwiriza y’ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ry’Amasezerano;
c) abakozi bahawe akazi ko kurengera imitungo
ndangamuco;
d) amakarita ndangamuntu ateganywa mu
Mabwiriza y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’Amasezerano.
3. Mu gihe cy’intambara, birabujijwe gukoresha
ikirango cyihariye mu bundi buryo butari
ubuvugwa mu bika bibanza by’iyi ngingo,
cyangwa gukoresha ku mpamvu iyo ari yo yose
ikirango gisa n’ikirango cyihariye
cy’Amasezerano.
4. Ikirango cyihariye ntigishobora gushyirwa ku
mutungo ndangamuco utimukanwa
kidaherekejwe n’inyandiko ibitangira
uruhushya iriho itariki n’umukono
w’umuyobozi ubifitiye ububasha w’igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano.
Igice cya IV: Aho Amasezerano akurikizwa

articles.heading: Ubwikorezi bujya mu mahanga Mu gihe iyimurwa ryemerewe ukurengerwa kwihariye rikozwe rigana ku butaka bw’ikindi
articles.text:
gihugu, uretse kugengwa n’ingingo ya 12
y’Amasezerano n’iya 17 y’aya Mabwiriza,
rinagengwa kandi n’ibi bikurikira:
a) Igihe cyose iyo mitungo ndangamuco iri ku
butaka bw’ikindi gihugu, icyo gihugu kiba
umubitsi wayo. Cyita kuri iyo mitungo ku
rugero rungana n’uko cyita ku mitungo
ndangamuco yacyo binganya agaciro
ugereranyije.
b) Igihugu kirengezi kizasubiza iyo mitungo ari
uko gusa intambara irangiye; igarurwa ryayo
rikorwe mu gihe cy’amezi atandatu uhereye ku
itariki byasabweho.
c) Mu byiciro bitandukanye ubwikorezi
bukorwamo no mu gihe iyo mitungo
ndangamuco icumbikiwe ku butaka bw’ikindi
gihugu, ntishobora gufatirwa cyangwa ngo
ishyirwe mu kudakorwaho haba ku wayizanye
cyangwa k’uyibitse. Icyakora, bibaye ngombwa
kugira ngo umutekano w’iyo mitungo ukomeze
kwitabwaho, igihugu kiyibitse, kibyemerewe
n’igihugu cyayizanye, gishobora kuyimurira ku
butaka bw’ikindi gihugu cya gatatu,
hubahirijwe ibisabwa biteganywa n’iyi ngingo.
d) Ubusabe bwo kuyishyira mu kurengerwa mu
buryo bwihariye bugomba kugaragaza ko
Igihugu igiye kwimurirwamo cyemera
ibiteganywa n’iyi ngingo.

articles.heading: Intambara itari ku urwego mpuzamahanga 1. Mu gihe cy’intambara itari ku rwego mpuzamahanga kandi ibereye ku butaka bwa
articles.text:
kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano, buri gihugu kiri mu ntambara
gisabwa gukurikiza byibura ibikubiye muri aya
Masezerano bifitanye isano n’iyubahwa
ry’imitungo ndangamuco.
2. Ibihugu biri mu ntambara bigomba kwihatira
gukurikiza, binyuze mu kugirana amasezerano
yihariye, ibindi biteganywa muri aya
Masezerano byaba byose cyangwa igice
cyabyo.
3. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye
rishinzwe guteza imbere Uburezi, Ubumenyi
n’Umuco rishobora gutanga ubufasha bwaryo
ku bihugu biri mu ntambara.
4. Ikurikizwa ry’ibikubiye mu ngingo zibanza
ntirigira ingaruka ku mimerere y’impande
zihanganye imbere y’amategeko.
Igice cya VII: Ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’Amasezerano

articles.heading: Ishyirwa ry’ikirango ahantu no ku bintu 1. Uburyo bwo gushyira ikirango cyihariye ahantu n’urugero kigaragaramo byemezwa
articles.text:
n’abayobozi babifitiye ububasha ba buri gihugu
kiri mu Masezerano. Ikirango gishobora
kugaragazwa nko ku mabendera cyangwa ku
dutambaro twambarwa ku kuboko. Gishobora
gushushanywa ku bintu hakoreshejwe amarangi
cyangwa gushyirwaho mu bundi buryo
bukwiye.
2. Icyakora, bitabangamiye ikoreshwa rishobora
kubaho ry’ibindi bimenyetso byuzuye
kurushaho, mu gihe cy’intambara, ikirango
kigomba gushyirwa ku buryo bukoreshwa mu
gutwara ibintu mu bihe biteganywa mu ngingo
ya 12 n’iya 13 z’Amasezerano ku buryo
kigaragara neza ku manywa, umuntu yaba
arebera mu kirere cyangwa ku butaka. Ikirango
kigomba kandi gushyirwaho ku buryo
kigaragara neza urebeye ku butaka:
) ku ntera zidahindagurika zihagije mu
kugaragaza neza umuzenguruko w’agace
karimo ibimenyetso ndangamateka karengerwa
ku buryo bwihariye;
b) ku bwinjiriro bw’ahari indi mitungo
ndangamuco itimukanwa irengerwa mu buryo
bwihariye.

articles.heading: Kugaragaza abantu 1. Abantu bavugwa mu gace ka (b) n’aka (c) tw’igika cya 2 cy’ingingo ya 17 y’Amasezerano
articles.text:
bashobora kwambara agatambaro ko ku kaboko
kariho ikirango cyihariye, katanzwe kandi
kariho kashe y’abayobozi babifitiye ububasha.
2. Abo bantu bagendana ikarika ndangamuntu
yihariye iriho ikirango cyihariye. Iyo karita
igomba kugaragaza nibura izina bwite
n’amazina y’ingereka, itariki y’amavuko, izina
ry’icyubahiro cyangwa ipeti n’umurimo bya
nyirayo. Ikarita igomba kuba iriho ifoto ya
nyirayo n’umukono we cyangwa igikumwe cye,
cyangwa byombi. Igomba kandi kuba iriho
kashe y’umuriro y’abayobozi babifitiye
ububasha.
3. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
kigomba gutegura ikarita ndangamuntu yacyo
gishingiye ku rugero rugaragara ku mugereka
w’aya Mabwiriza. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano bizohererezanya ingero
z’amakarita yabyo. Iyo bishobotse, buri karita
ndangamuntu itegurwa ari inyandukuro ebyiri
nibura, inyandukuro imwe muri zo ikabikwa
n’igihugu cyayitanze.
4. Abantu bavugwa haruguru ntibashobora
kwamburwa amakarita abaranga cyangwa ngo
babuzwe uburenganzira bwo kwambara
agatambaro ko ku kuboko, keretse gusa hari
impamvu yumvikana.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo kunga 1. Ibihugu birengezi byitangira gukora ubuhuza igihe cyose bibona ko ari ingenzi mu kurengera
articles.text:
imitungo ndangamuco, by’umwihariko nko mu
gihe impande zihanganye zitumvikana ku
ishyirwa mu bikorwa cyangwa isobanurwa
ry’ingingo z’aya Masezerano cyangwa
iz’Amabwiriza y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo.
2. Ku bw’ibyo, buri gihugu mu bihugu
birengezi, kibisabwe na rumwe mu mpande
zihanganye, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami
ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Burezi,
Ubumenyi n’Umuco, cyangwa kibyibwirije,
gishobora gusaba impande zihanganye ko
hatumizwa inama y’abazihagarariye,
by’umwihariko abayobozi bashinzwe kurengera
imitungo ndangamuco, ikabera ahantu
hatoranyijwe neza ku butaka bw’igihugu
kidafite aho kibogamiye. Impande zihanganye
zigomba gushyigikira icyo cyifuzo zigejejweho
cyo gukora inama. Ibihugu birengezi bisaba
impande zihanganye kwemera ko hatumirwa
umuntu uva mu gihugu kidafite aho kibogamiye
cyangwa wagenwe n’Umuyobozi Mukuru
w’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku
Burezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco (UNESCO),
kugira ngo aze muri iyo nama anayiyobore.

articles.heading: Ubufasha bwa UNESCO 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora gusaba Ishami ry’Umuryango
articles.text:
w’Abibumbye ryita ku Burezi, Ubumenyi
n’Umuco (UNESCO) kubiha ubufasha mu bya
tekinike mu bijyanye no gutegura uburyo bwo
kurengera imitungo ndangamuco yabyo
cyangwa mu bijyanye n’ikindi kibazo cyose
cyavuka mu ikurikizwa ry’aya Masezerano
n’Amabwiriza y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo.
UNESCO itanga ubufasha ikurikije ibiri muri
gahunda zayo n’amikoro yayo.
2. UNESCO ifite ububasha bwo kugeza
ibyifuzo byayo ku bihugu bihuriye muri aya
Masezerano ibyibwirije.

articles.heading: Amasezerano adasanzwe 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora kugirana amasezerano adasanzwe ku
articles.text:
kibazo cyose bibona ko ari ngombwa gukemura
mu buryo butandukanye.
2. Nta masezerano yihariye n’amwe ashobora
gukorwa ngo agabanye na gato ukurengerwa
aya Masezerano mpuzamahanga ateganyiriza
imitungo ndangamuco n’abakozi bashinzwe
kuyirengera.

articles.heading: Imenyekanisha ry’Amasezerano Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byiyemeza kumenyekanisha mu buryo
articles.text:
bwagutse bushoboka, mu gihe cy’amahoro no
mu gihe cy’intambara, inyandiko y’aya
Masezerano n’iy’Amabwiriza y’ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ryayo. Byiyemeza kandi kuyinjiza mu
nyigisho zigenewe abasirikare, igihe bishoboka
bikayinjiza no mu nyigisho zihabwa abasivili,
ku buryo amahame yayo amenywa n’abaturage
bose, by’umwihariko ingabo n’abakozi
bashinzwe kurengera imitungo ndangamuco.

articles.heading: Ihindura mu ndimi na raporo 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano binyuze ku Muyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami
articles.text:
ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye rishinzwe
Uburezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco, bihana ihindura
mu ndimi ryemewe ry’aya Masezerano
n’amabwiriza y’iyubahirizwa ryayo.
2. Byongeye kandi, nibura incuro imwe mu
myaka ine, bishyikiriza Umuyobozi Mukuru
raporo ikubiyemo amakuru yose bibona ko
akwiriye gutangwa, yerekeranye n’ingamba
zafashwe, zateguwe cyangwa ziteganywa
n’ubuyobozi bwabyo mu rwego rwo gushyira
mu bikorwa aya Masezerano n’Amabwiriza
yerekeye ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo.

articles.heading: Inama 1. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Burezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco, abyemerewe n’Inama
articles.text:
Nshingwabikorwa, ashobora gutumiza inama
z’abahagarariye ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano. Agomba gutumiza iyo nama iyo
nibura kimwe cya gatanu (1/5) cy’ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano kibisabye.
2. Bitabangamiye indi mirimo yose yashinzwe
n’aya Masezerano cyangwa Amabwiriza
y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo, inama ifite
inshingano zo kwiga ibibazo birebana
n’iyubahirizwa ry’aya Masezerano
n’Amabwiriza y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo, no
kubitangaho ibyifuzonama.
3. Inama ishobora na none gukora ivugururwa
ry’aya Masezerano cyangwa Amabwiriza
y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo iyo ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bihagarariwe
bigeze ku bwiganze bw’ibiyahuriyemo, kandi
hakurikijwe ibikubiye mu ngingo ya 39.

articles.heading: Ibihano Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byiyemeza gufata ingamba zose za ngombwa, mu rwego rw’amategeko mpanabyaha yabyo,
articles.text:
hagamijwe gukurikirana no guhana mu rwego
mpanabyaha cyangwa mu rwego
rw’imyitwarire, abantu bose bakora cyangwa
bategeka ikorwa ry’icyaha kuri aya Masezerano
hatitawe ku bwenegihugu bwabo.
Ingingo zisoza
Ingingoya 29: Indimi
1. Aya Masezerano akozwe mu nyandiko ziri
mu ndimi z’Icyesipanyolo, Icyongereza,
Igifaransa n’Ikirusiya, izo nyandiko uko ari
enye zinganya agaciro.
2.Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye
rishinzwe Uburezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco
rikoresha ihindura mu zindi ndimi zemewe
zikoreshwa mu nama rusange yaryo.

articles.heading: Umukono Aya Masezerano ahabwa itariki ya 14 Gicurasi 1954 kandi kugeza ku wa 31 Ukuboza 1954,
articles.text:
yemerewe gushyirwaho umukono n’ibihugu
byose byatumiwe mu nama yabereye i La Haye
ku wa 21 Mata 1954 kugeza ku wa 14 Gicurasi
1954.

articles.heading: Kwemezwa burundu 1. Aya Masezerano yemezwa burundu n’ibihugu byayashyizeho umukono hakurikijwe
articles.text:
uburyo buteganywa n’amategeko nshinga
yabyo.
2. Inyandiko ziyemeza burundu zishyikirizwa
Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye rishinzwe Uburezi, Ubumenyi
n’Umuco.

articles.heading: Kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu buhuriye kuri aya Masezerano Uhereye ku itariki atangirira gukurikizwa, aya
articles.text:
Masezerano yemerera ibihugu byose bivugwa
mu ngingo ya 30, bitayashyizeho umukono,
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho,
kimwe n’ikindi gihugu cyose cyatumiwe
n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye
rishinzwe Uburezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho.
Ukwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
biyahuriyeho gukorwa hatangwa inyandiko
yabyo ishyikirizwa Umuyobozi Mukuru
w’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye
rishinzwe Uburezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco.

articles.heading: Gutangira gukurikizwa 1. Aya Masezerano atangira gukurikizwa hashize amezi atatu hatanzwe inyandiko eshanu
articles.text:
zo kuyemeza burundu.
2. Nyuma yaho, kuri buri gihugu kiyarimo,
azatangira gukurikizwa hashize amezi atatu
gitanze inyandiko yacyo yo kuyemeza burundu
cyangwa yo kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
biyahuriyeho.
3. Imimerere ivugwa mu ngingo ya 18 n’iya 19
ituma aya Masezerano ahita atangira
gukurikizwa ako kanya ku bihugu biri mu
ntambara bitanze inyandiko zo kuyemeza
burundu cyangwa kuyemera haba mbere
cyangwa nyuma yo gutangira kw’imirwano
cyangwa y’ifatwa ry’ahantu. Muri ibyo bihe,
Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye ryita ku Burezi, Ubumenyi
n’Umuco, yohereza amamenyesha avugwa mu
ngingo ya 38 akoresheje uburyo bwihuta
kurusha ubundi.

articles.heading: Iyubahirizwa risesuye 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano ku itariki y’itangira gukurikizwa ryayo, kigomba
articles.text:
gufata ingamba zose za ngombwa kugira ngo
aya Masezerano ashobore kubahirizwa mu
buryo busesuye mu gihe cy’amezi atandatu
uhereye ku itariki azaba yatangiriyeho
gukurikizwa.
2. Icyo gihe kiba icy’amezi atandatu uhereye
igihe cyatangiye inyandiko zacyo zo kwemeza
burundu cyangwa kwemera kuba kimwe mu
bihugu biyahuriyeho nyuma y’itariki
Amasezerano yatangiriyeho gukurikizwa.

articles.heading: Kwinjiza izindi ntara muri aya Masezerano Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kiri muri aya Masezerano, mu gihe cyo kuyemeza burundu
articles.text:
cyangwa cyo kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
biyahuriyeho cyangwa se igihe icyo ari cyo
cyose nyuma yaho, gishobora gutangaza,
binyuze mu imenyesha gishyikiriza Umuyobozi
Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye ryita ku Burezi, Ubumenyi
n’Umuco, ko aya Masezerano azakurikizwa mu
ntara zose cyangwa muri imwe mu ntara icyo
gihugu kireberera mu bijyanye n’ububanyi
n’amahanga. Iryo menyesha ritangira kugira
agaciro hashize amezi atatu akurikira itariki
ryakiriweho.

articles.heading: Isano hagati y’aya Masezerano n’ayemejwe mbere 1. Mu mibanire hagati y’ibihugu bihuriye ku Masezerano y’i La Haye yerekeranye
articles.text:
n’amategeko yanditse n’ashingiye ku mico
akurikizwa mu bihe by’intambara yo ku butaka
(IV), n’arebana n’Iraswa ry’Ibisasu rikorwa
n’Ingabo Zirwanira mu Mazi mu gihe
cy’Intambara (IX), yaba ayo ku wa 29
Nyakanga 1899 cyangwa ayo ku wa 18
Ukwakira 1907, kandi biri no muri aya
Masezerano, aya Masezerano afatwa
nk’ayuzuza Amasezerano ya IX yavuzwe
haruguru n’Amabwiriza ari ku Mugereka
w’Amasezerano ya IV yavuzwe haruguru, kandi
asimbuje ikirango gisobanurwa mu ngingo ya 5
y’Amasezerano ya IX yavuzwe haruguru
ikirango cyihariye gisobanurwa mu ngingo ya
16 y’aya Masezerano, mu bihe gikoreshwamo
biteganywa n’aya Masezerano n’Amabwiriza
y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo.
2. Mu mibanire y’ibihugu bihuriye ku
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga y’i Washingitoni
yo ku wa 15 Mata 1935 yerekeye kurengera
ibigo by’ubugeni n’iby’ubuhanga n’inyubako
ndangamateka (Amasezerano ya Roerich),
kandi biri muri aya Masezerano, aya
Masezerano yuzuza Amasezerano ya Roerich
kandi asimbuza ibendera ryihariye risobanurwa
mu ngingo ya III y’Amasezerano ya Roerich
ikirango cyihariye gisobanurwa mu ngingo ya
16 y’aya Masezerano, mu bihe gikoreshwamo
biteganywa n’aya Masezerano n’Amabwiriza
y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo.

articles.heading: Ukwivana mu Masezerano 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishobora kuyivanamo mu izina ryacyo bwite
articles.text:
cyangwa mu izina ry’intara gishinzwe mu
mibanire mpuzamahanga yayo.
2. Ukwivanamo kumenyeshwa mu nyandiko
ishyikirizwa Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami
ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye rishinzwe
Uburezi, Ubuhanga n’Umuco.
3. Ukwivanamo kugira agaciro umwaka umwe
nyuma y’iyakirwa ry’inyandiko yacyo. Igihugu
cyivanye mu Masezerano kiri mu ntambara,
ukwivanamo gukomeza guhagarikwa kugeza
imirwano irangiye kandi no mu gihe cyose
ibikorwa byo gusubiza imitungo ndangamuco
mu gihugu byakomotsemo bitararangira.
Ingingo ya38 : Imenyesha
Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye rishinzwe Uburezi, Ubumenyi
n’Umuco amenyesha ibihugu byose bivugwa
mu ngingo ya 30 n’iya 32 kimwe n’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye itangwa ry’inyandiko zose zo
kwemeza burundu, kwemera kuba kimwe mu
bihugu buhuriye kuri aya Masezerano cyangwa
iyemerwa ryayo bivugwa mu ngingo ya 31, 32
n’iya 39, kimwe n’imenyesha n’ukwivanamo
biteganywa mu ngingo ya 35, 37 n’iya 39.

articles.heading: Ivugururwa rigira agaciro ku bihugu byose bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano, mu gihe cy’iminsi 90 uhereye igihe iryo
articles.text:
menyesha ryakorewe.
4. Umuyobozi Mukuru atumiza Inama
y’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano kugira
ngo isuzume icyifuzo cyo kuyavugurura iyo
yabisabwe n’ibihugu birenze kimwe cya gatatu
(1/3) cy’ibihugu biri muri aya Masezerano.
5. Amavugururwa y’aya Masezerano cyangwa
ay’Amabwiriza y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo
akozwe mu buryo buteganywa mu gika
kibanziriza iki atangira gukurikizwa ari uko
gusa ibihugu byose biri muri aya Masezerano
byitabiriye Inama byatoye biyemeza kandi buri
gihugu mu bihugu byose bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano kikaba cyarayemeye.
6. Kwemera amavugururwa y’aya Masezerano
cyangwa ay’Amabwiriza y’ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ryayo aba yemejwe n’Inama ivugwa
mu gika cya 4 n’icya 5, gukorwa hashyikirizwa
inyandiko yabyo Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami
ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Burezi,
Ubumenyi n’Umuco.
7. Nyuma yo gutangira gukurikizwa
kw’amavugururwa y’aya Masezerano cyangwa
ay’Amabwiriza y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo,
inyandiko yavuguruwe y’aya Masezerano
cyangwa y’Amabwiriza y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ryayo ni yo yonyine yemerewe kwemezwa
burundu cyangwa yemerera igihugu kwemera
kuba kimwe mu bihugu biyihuriyeho.

articles.heading: Ivugurura ry’Amasezerano n’Amabwiriza y’ikurikizwa ryayo 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
gishobora gutanga icyifuzo cy’amavugururwa
kuri aya Masezerano no ku Mabwiriza
y’ikurikizwa ryayo. Ivugururwa ryose ryasabwe
rimenyeshwa Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami
ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Burezi,
Ubumenyi n’Umuco, na we agashyikiriza
inyandiko buri gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano asaba kumumenyesha mu mezi
ane:
(a) niba byifuza ko hatumizwa Inama yo kwiga
ku ivugururwa ryasabwe;
(b) cyangwa niba bifite igitekerezo cyo
kwemera ivugururwa ryasabwe nta nama
iteranye;
(c) cyangwa niba bifite igitekerezo cyo kwanga
ubusabe bw’ivugururwa nta nama igombye
gutumizwa;
2.Umuyobozi Mukuru ashyikiriza ibisubizo
yakiriye mu iyubahirizwa ry’igika cya mbere
cy’iyi ngingo ibihugu byose bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano.
3. Iyo ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
byamenyesheje mu gihe giteganyijwe
Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye rishinzwe Uburezi, Ubumenyi
n’Umuco uko bibibona hakurikijwe agace ka (b)
k’igika cya mbere cy’iyi ngingo, ko bifite
igitekerezo cyo kwemeza ivugururwa nta nama
iteranye, imenyeshwa ry’icyemezo cyabyo
rikorwa n’Umuyobozi Mukuru hakurikijwe

articles.heading: Iyandikishwa Hakurikijwe ingingo ya 102 y’Amasezerano ashyiraho Umuryango w’Abibumbye, aya Masezerano yandikishwa mu Bunyamabanga
articles.text:
bw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ku busabe
bw’Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami
ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye rishinzwe
Uburezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco.
BAMAZE KWEMERA IBIKUBIYE MURI
AYA MASEZERANO, abahawe ububasha
n’ibihugu byabo bashyize umukono kuri aya
Masezerano.
Bikorewe i La Haye, ku wa 14 Gicurasi 1954,
mu nyandiko imwe ishyirwa mu
ishyinguranyandiko ry’Ishami ry’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye rishinzwe Uburezi, Ubumenyi
n’Umuco, kandi inyandukuro zayo zihuje
n’umwimerere, zishyikirizwa ibihugu byose
bivugwa mu ngingo ya 30 n’iya 32, kimwe
n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye.
